issues.problem: av-zenzen explain glossed あまり寒くない as 'a little cold' (it means 'not very cold').
av-zenzen mistake 1 'bad' sentence 日本語はとても話せません is grammatical (means 'can't possibly speak'), so not really a mistake.
issues.action: Replaced with ×今日はとても寒くないです → 今日はあまり寒くないです.

issues.problem: av-nakanaka explain claimed a positive verb is always wrong; なかなかやるね / なかなか似合う are standard praise.
issues.action: Restated the edge: event reports need the negative; a positive verb works only as praise.

issues.problem: av-nakanaka mistake note repeated the over-strong 'with a verb, only negative' claim.
av-nakanaka tip relied on the same false verb rule.
issues.action: Rewrote tip around meaning (keeps not happening vs praise).

issues.problem: av-nakanaka example English 'it's wearing me out' over-translated 困っています.
issues.action: Changed to 'which is a real problem'.

issues.problem: av-masaka mistake note omitted the very common なんて ending.
issues.action: Added なんて to the list of endings.
